# cato_sites (Data Source)

Retrieves socket sites.

## Example Usage

```terraform
## Providers ###
provider "cato" {
  baseurl    = "https://api.catonetworks.com/api/v1/graphql2"
  token      = var.cato_token
  account_id = var.account_id
}

### Data Source Usage ###

# Example: Read all sites
data "cato_sites" "all" {}

# Example: Read sites by name
data "cato_sites" "by_name" {
  name_filter = ["Datacenter-NYC", "Branch-LON"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_filter` (List of String) List of site names to filter

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of sites (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `connection_type` (String) Site connection type (e.g. socket model)
- `description` (String) Description
- `id` (String) ID
- `name` (String) Name
- `operational_status` (String) Site operational status
- `type` (String) Site type (e.g. BRANCH, HEADQUARTERS, CLOUD_DC)
